lines.text: What if a whole year of *rain* fell on New York... in five seconds?
New York gets about *forty-nine inches* of rain a year. That's a meter and a quarter of water.
Just *two feet* of moving water can float most cars.
Every car in Times Square is now a boat.
New York's sewers handle about one and three quarter inches an hour. This was *twenty thousand* times more.
Follow for more. What should fall next?
